name: Air Fryer Cookies
description: Quick, small-batch cookies made in an air fryer with a soft, hardened finish.
recipe: Add half a cup of unsalted butter (ideally) to a mixing bowl
Add 1/4 cup granulated Sugar
Add 1/4 cup brown sugar
Mix using a mixer thoroughly until cloudy
Add a dash of vanilla extract
1 1/2 Cup of all purpose flour
1/4 Tbsp baking soda
1/4 Tbsp Salt
Mix again thoroughly
Add choco chips/walnuts/raisins (optional)
Take out small balls of dough and place on parchment paper on air fryer
Preheat if needed, heat for around 15 mins at 150'C
Let them cool for 5 mins and harden
Enjoy!

name: Aloo Beans
description: A flavorful and crispy North Indian dry vegetable stir-fry with potatoes and french beans.
recipe: Heat Oil in pan and add cumin seeds and Hing + green chilli
Sauté the potatoes (don't boil them first)
Add chopped beans, turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder and salt
Steam cook i.e. cover pan with lid and let it cook for 10-12 mins, stir to avoid sticking
Add amchur powder and garam masala and saute another 2 mins

name: Chicken Fried Rice
description: A classic stir-fried rice dish with chicken, eggs, and mixed vegetables.
recipe: Cook diced chicken seperately ideally with ginger garlic paste
Start out with eggs beaten and cooked into a bhurji
Seperately add oil and cook your veggies with mild seasoning
Add cooked rice next with oil to fry it along with veggies
Add a dash of soy sauce and vinegar
Add cooked chicken on top and let it fry well

name: Frittata
description: An Italian-style open-faced omelet loaded with caramelized onions and seasonal vegetables.
recipe: Add around 6 eggs in mixing bowl
Add 80 mL / 1/3 cup heavy cream whisk slowly careful to not introduce bubbles
Add chopped onion in olive oil till caramelize then add garlic minced
Add some veggies, like zucchini, potato, capsicum etc thinner slices
Stir the oil pan can add green leafs a little later
Add cheese on veggies
Add egg mix on top
In the pan cook till the edge sets then move to oven sprinkle with parsley/basil

name: Marinara
description: A simple and rich tomato sauce with aromatic garlic, onion, and fresh basil.
recipe: Puree Tomatoes
Finely chop onion and garlic
Add olive oil and onion
Once caramelized add garlic
Add tomato Puree and let it simmer
Add pepper, oregano, red chilli flake
Add basil leafs chopped up on top

name: Palak Paneer
description: Classic Indian dish consisting of paneer in a thick paste made from pureed spinach.
recipe: Cut spinach leaves removing hard stems
Boil water in a pan and add cut spinach leaves, blanch and strain
To make masala add oil, cumin, fine cut onion, chilli and garlic and ginger
Fry until the onion caramelize and add finely chopped tomato
Let it cool off and add with blanched spinach in mixer and let it run
Add butter/oil, add turmeric, red chilli, coriander powder and mix on low heat and add spinach
Add some water for right consistency and 1 tbsp salt
Cook on low heat for 5 mins
Add chunks of paneer and cook for 5 more mins
Add Cream/yogurt/milk (optional)

name: Pancakes
description: Fluffy, easy-to-make breakfast pancakes using pantry staples.
recipe: Whisk all together until thick and foamy
Put on Flat pan and heat until bubbly
Flip

name: Poha
description: A light and healthy savory breakfast made with flattened rice and tempered spices.
recipe: Add oil in pan, heat and add peanuts, mustard seed, hing
Add finely chopped onions first, then chopped chilli and tomato
Add water to poha and drain immediately to avoid sogginess
Combine the two add salt, sugar, and tumeric

name: Sirke Vala Pyaaz
description: Bright pink, tangy restaurant-style pickled onions using beetroot for color.
recipe: Stir the vinegar, water, sugar, and salt in a jar until dissolved
Add the onions and beetroot slices to the jar
Ensure onions are fully covered by the liquid
Let the jar sit on your counter for 24 hours

name: Tomato Soup
description: Warm, comforting tomato soup balanced with a touch of sugar and black pepper.
recipe: Finally chop yellow onion and mince garlic
Simmer butter/olive oil and add onion to sauté
Add garlic and stir for a few mins (do not burn)
Add purée of tomato and water/stock
Add 1 spoon sugar, black pepper, and pinch of salt
Let it simmer for up to 20 mins
If thick, mash it in the blender

name: Chilli Tofu
description: An Indo-Chinese vegan dish featuring crispy air-fried tofu tossed in a spicy, tangy, and slightly sweet sauce with peppers and onions.
ingredients: 1 lb Extra firm tofu (pressed and cubed)
recipe: Press tofu to remove moisture, cut into 1-inch cubes, and marinate with chili powder, 1 tsp salt, pepper, ginger/garlic paste, vinegar, 1 tbsp water, and 2 tbsp cornstarch for 10 mins
Preheat air fryer to 400°F, spray with oil, and cook tofu for 10 mins until crispy
Heat oil in a pan and sauté scallion whites, ginger, garlic, and green chili for 2 mins
Add onions and peppers with 1 tsp salt; sauté for 3 mins until slightly softened
In a small bowl, whisk soy sauce, chili garlic paste, sugar, and 1/4 cup water, then pour into the pan
Mix 1 tbsp cornstarch with remaining 1/4 cup water to make a slurry; add to pan and stir until the sauce thickens
Toss in the air-fried tofu and green scallions, heating through just before serving

name: Honey Garlic Chicken
description: Sticky, tender boneless chicken thighs coated in a sweet and savory garlic, soy, and honey sauce.
recipe: Toss chicken pieces in a bowl with cornflour, salt, and pepper until fully coated
Heat oil in a large skillet over high heat
Fry chicken until golden brown (approx. 4–5 mins on one side, 2 mins on the other)
Add butter to the pan to melt, then stir in minced garlic on medium heat
In a small bowl, whisk honey, stock, vinegar, and soy sauce
Pour sauce into the pan and bring to a boil
Simmer for 4–5 mins until the sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through
Serve with or without rice

name: Cottage Cheese Berry Bowl
description: A quick, high-protein breakfast or snack featuring creamy cottage cheese topped with a variety of fresh berries and crunchy almonds.
recipe: Scoop the cottage cheese into a medium serving bowl
Wash and dry the blueberries, raspberries, and blackberries
Arrange the berries on top of the cottage cheese
Sprinkle the slivered almonds over the fruit for crunch
Drizzle with honey if a sweeter flavor is desired and serve immediately

name: Pineapple-Mango-Peach Chia Seed Smoothie
description: A refreshing tropical smoothie packed with fiber and omega-3s from chia seeds, featuring a vibrant blend of pineapple, mango, and peach.
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh or frozen pineapple chunks
1 cup unsweetened almond milk (or milk of choice)
recipe: Combine mango, peach, pineapple, milk, yogurt, and sweetener (if using) in a blender.
Blend on high until the mixture is completely smooth and creamy.
Add the chia seeds to the blender.
Pulse a few times or stir manually to incorporate the seeds without fully pulverizing them.
Pour into a glass and let sit for 2-3 minutes to allow the chia seeds to thicken slightly before serving.

name: Bang Bang Chicken Wraps
description: A high-protein, creamy, and spicy-sweet wrap featuring shredded chicken tossed in a lighter yogurt-mayo bang bang sauce with crunchy pickled slaw.
ingredients: Rice vinegar, sugar, and salt (for slaw)
Light mayo and plain Greek-style yogurt
recipe: Toss slaw mix with rice vinegar, sugar, salt, and chili flakes; set aside to lightly pickle.
In a bowl, whisk together light mayo, Greek yogurt, sweet chili sauce, sriracha, honey, and vinegar/lime juice to create the sauce.
Stir the shredded chicken into the sauce until thoroughly coated and creamy.
Spread the bang bang chicken mixture down the center of each wrap.
Top with the pickled slaw, crispy shallots, green onions, and fresh herbs.
Roll burrito-style and serve immediately, or pan-fry for 30 seconds per side for a crispy finish.

name: Shahi Paneer
description: A rich and creamy restaurant-style paneer dish cooked in a velvety tomato-onion gravy infused with aromatic spices, cashews, and melon seeds.
ingredients: 2 Green cardamoms, 1 Black cardamom, and 2-3 Cloves
1 Bay leaf and 1 tbsp Cumin seeds
1/2 tsp Turmeric and 1 tbsp Kashmiri red chili powder
1 tbsp Coriander powder and 1 tbsp crushed Kasuri methi
2 tbsp Milk powder and 1/2 cup Milk
3 tbsp Oil, 1 tsp Salt, and 1/2 tsp Sugar
recipe: Boil onions, tomatoes, garlic, green chilies, cardamoms, cloves, and 1 cup water in a covered pan for 5-7 minutes; let cool and blend into a smooth puree.
Heat oil in a pan, add bay leaf, cumin seeds, turmeric, and red chili powder, then stir in the puree and salt and sauté for 5-7 minutes.
Blend cashews, melon seeds, milk powder, and milk into a smooth paste, then stir it into the cooking gravy.
Add coriander powder and Kasuri methi, pour in 1/2 cup water, cover, and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the paneer cubes and simmer on low heat for 3-4 minutes.
Mix in the sugar, garnish with fresh coriander leaves, and serve hot.

name: Mixed Veg Paneer Jalfrezi
description: A vibrant and crunchy stir-fry featuring paneer, mushrooms, and assorted vegetables tossed with garlic and tomatoes in a dry, flavorful style.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
recipe: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan, sear the paneer cubes until lightly golden, then remove and set aside.
In the same pan on high heat, fry the mushrooms until browned and dry, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil, sauté the chopped garlic and onions until soft, then add tomatoes and cook down into a thick paste.
Toss in the carrots and beans with 2 tablespoons of water, cover, and steam on medium heat until fork-tender but crisp.
Turn the heat to high, add the bell peppers, cooked mushrooms, and seared paneer, and toss vigorously for 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper, mix well, and serve hot.

name: Garlic Ginger Chicken Stir-Fry
description: A high-protein, low-calorie stir-fry combining lean chicken breast with crisp broccoli and peppers in a savory garlic-ginger glaze.
recipe: Cube the chicken breast, slice the bell pepper, and mince the garlic and ginger
Heat sesame oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat
Add cubed chicken breast and cook until browned for 5-6 minutes
Add minced garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant
Add broccoli and bell pepper, tossing frequently for 4 minutes until tender-crisp
Stir in the soy sauce, cook for 1 final minute, and serve
